To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

gel‐IEF with real‐time pH gradient visualization is the method of choice for the determination of the pI of proteins, and that it is the method that allows one to determine the pI′ of proteins with a precision and accuracy that are not achievable with any other method.
the “blindness” of IEF can be remedied by real‐time visualization of the pH in the sample position, which can be achieved by automated scanning of the fluorescence emitted by the CAs.

the fluorescence of the CAs in the HPGE 1000 apparatus can be used to follow in real time the “life cycle of the pH gradient” and that the fluorescence pattern of the CAs can be used to visualize and to calibrate the pH gradient.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the renaissance of IEF with SCAMs, which has been in decline in favor of IPG‐IEF since the introduction of the latter.
the rehabilitation of carrier ampholytes for use in IEF, which was considered to have been “replaced” by IPG‐IEF.
the rehabilitation of the synthetic carrier ampholytes as a tool for IEF and the demonstration of their usefulness in the HPGE system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the “carrier ampholyte” method is rehabilitated and that the “immobilized pH gradient” method is not necessary.
the “blindness” of IEF is not due to the pH gradient, but to the absence of a method for visualizing it in the position of a protein sample.
gel IEF on SCAMs is rehabilitated by real‐time fluorescence scanning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the method of gel IEF on pH gradients visualizable in real‐time, as presented in this article, rehabilitates the carrier ampholytes as a tool for protein IEF.
the method is a valuable tool in IEF.
carrier ampholytes are rehabilitated by the application of the real‐time pH gradient visualization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IEF with synthetic carrier ampholytes, which is the method of choice for the resolution of complex mixtures, can be used with confidence, if only the pH gradient is visualized in real time.
the pH gradient is the most important factor in IEF.

the “blindness” of IEF is a major problem that can be remedied by the application of a fluorescence scanning method, which allows to follow the pH of the gel in the position of a protein as a function time and to assign a pI′ value to the protein.
